title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Artist Returns With Special Tribute to Fall’s Darkest Romance
content:
The artist behind Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has returned amid the manga’s hiatus with a special new tribute to help celebrate the debut of Firefly Wedding’ s big anime. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway as fans are now seeing a whole new wave of anime making their respective debuts, and that includes a dark new romance series that’s already started to build a lot of buzz. That’s going even further with a special tribute from Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End’ s artist to help boost that even more.

The anime adaptation for Oreco Tachibana’s Firefly Wedding has officially made its debut as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and it’s already looking like it’s going to be the next Shogakukan anime hit. As part of the same publishing company, Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End artist Tsukasa Abe has shared a special tribute artwork to help celebrate the new anime’s premiere and it’s a cool way to get introduced to Firefly Wedding ‘s main duo. You can check it out below.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Artist Shares New Firefly Wedding Tribute

Firefly Wedding has already been a popular manga series since its original debut in 2023 , and wrapped its run earlier this Summer. This made the new anime the first new release for the franchise in the time since, so it’s about to reach a whole new level of recognition with an adaptation that has a clear runway towards its eventual finale. The series introduces a young woman dying of a disease who makes a last ditch effort to marry an assassin in order to redeem herself in her family’s eyes before her eventual death. Which is a dark start to this central romance.

Takahiro Kamei directed the new series for david production ( the studio behind the JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure and Fire Force f ranchises ) with Yukiko Aikei designing the characters, Yuko Kakihara providing the scripts, and NOGRID composing the music. The central voice cast for the anime include the likes of Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya, Koki Uchiyama as Shinpei Goto, Kent Ito as Kotaro Ogawa, and Kenjiro Tsuda as Mitsueda. The opening theme for its is titled “Period” as performed by iri, and you can check it out in action with the creditless sequence in the video below.

How to Watch Firefly Wedding

If you wanted to check out Firefly Wedding as it airs its new episodes through the Fall, you can now find it streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll. There’s only one episode available at this time, but there will be an English dub release for it at a later date (which has yet to be confirmed by Crunchyroll). This new anime won’t be the only new release for the franchise on the horizon either as it’s getting ready for a multi-platform launch with another big adaptation now in the works.

Shortly after the debut of the anime’s premiere episode, Firefly Wedding also announced that a new live-action series was in development . Currently scheduled for a release sometime next year in Japan, there have yet to be any international release details revealed for it. Nor have there been many production staff or cast details revealed. But how are you liking Firefly Wedding’ s anime debut so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Kadokawa Apologizes After Using Character Design Reference Without Permission for Pitch-Black Infatuation Manga
content:
The editorial department of Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine apologized last week for unauthorized use of Ieri Komen's character designs for some characters in Kei Natsumi 's manga adaptation of Rokakoen 's Pitch-Black Infatuation ( Shikkoku no Bojō ) novel. The editorial department stated that, normally, permissions are acquired before the serialization of the manga even begins. However, this time, the character designs were used without permission. The Young Ace editorial department took full responsibility for the mistake, with neither the original creator Rokakoen nor the manga creator Kei Natsumi bearing any responsibility. The department also apologized to Ieri Komen.

The Young Ace editorial department provided the timeline to explain how it made the mistake. Kei Natsumi 's pre-production on the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga begin in August 2025. The Young Ace editorial department communicated with the Kadokawa Horror Bunko editorial department (which publishes both of Rokakoen 's original Festival of Heresies and Pitch-Black Infatuation novels), saying that it would like permission to use Ieri Komen's character designs from their manga adaptation of Festival of Heresies . It specifically wanted to use the characters Rumi Sasaki and Yukiyoshi Aoyama, who appear in both stories ( Pitch-Black Infatuation is set in the same world as Festival of Heresies ). The Young Ace editorial department said that it then received a reply from the Kadokawa Horror Bunko editorial department, with the latter saying that "It's probably also fine to use original character designs." The Young Ace editorial department then spoke with Kei Natsumi , moving forward with using Ieri Komen's character designs as reference, with the reply from Kadokawa Horror Bunko remaining vague, and still without permission from Ieri Komen.

After Kadokawa published the first compiled book volume of the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga, Ieri Komen contacted the Young Ace editorial department and determined that aside from the two earlier mentioned character designs, the Pitch-Black Infatuation manga had also used character designs for two other characters (Ishigami and Emi Shimamoto), as well as a background location.

Rokakoen published the Festival of Heresies ( Itan no Shukusai ) novel in May 2021, and the Pitch-Black Infatuation novel in February 2022, both under Kadokawa Horror Bunko. Yen Press published both novels in English in November 2024 and August 2025, respectively.

Komen launched the manga adaptation of Festival of Heresies in Kadokawa 's Comic Walker website in July 2023, and ended it with the second volume in November 2025.

Natsumi launched the manga adaptation of Pitch-Black Infatuation in Young Ace on March 4. Kadokawa released the manga's first volume on August 4.

title: Shueisha's Manga Million Adds Hiromasa Okujima's Together with Serial-san Manga
content:
The service describes the manga:

While a sensational serial murder case grips the public, the notorious killer himself shows up at the doorstep of Chihiro Yoshida, a college student who lives a life of absolute freedom and debauchery. To save his own skin, Yoshida makes a bizarre proposal: "Why don't you assume my identity and live here?" Can Yoshida really pull off this "impersonation cohabitation" with a serial killer (and maybe even have fun doing it)? The master artist renowned for drawing the ultimate handsome men, Hiromasa Okujima , brings you a twisted, chaotic comedy about a high-stakes charade where getting found out is absolutely not an option!

The manga debuted in Shueisha 's Grand Jump Mucha magazine on February 25.

Okujima launched the Baban Baban Ban Vampire manga in Akita Shoten 's Bessatsu Shōnen Champion magazine in October 2021. Akita Shoten published the manga's 14th compiled book volume on August 6. The series inspired an anime that streamed on Netflix in January 2025, along with a live-action film that opened in July 2025.

Viz Media 's SuBLime imprint for boys-love manga licensed SHOOWA and Okujima's Bad Boys, Happy Home ( Dōsei Yankee Akamatsu Seven ) manga, and released the first volume physically and digitally in July 2021. The pair launched the manga in Akita Shoten 's Kachi Comi magazine in April 2018.

Okujima's Katei Kyōshi no Kishi Knight Desu. (I Am the Home Tutor Kishi Knight.) manga inspired a live-action series adaptation that premiered on January 5. Okujima serialized the manga in Akita Shoten 's Nicchan Gecchan magazine in 2019. Akita Shoten published one volume for the manga.

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Releases Surprise English Dub for Entire Series After 2 Years
content:
Crunchyroll has surprisingly released the full English dub series release for one of their major Isekai anime titles after two years, and fans can catch up with it streaming now. The Fall 2026 anime schedule is now underway, and that includes some big Isekai titles that have returned for new seasons . But while some of these releases had English dub releases confirmed for their respective titles, there were a few shows left without one. That’s no longer the case for As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World .

The anime adaptation for Miraijin A’s As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World original light novels is currently airing its third season this Fall, but the franchise had been going all this time without an official English dub release. As a big surprise, however, Crunchyroll has now launched not only the English dub for the first episode of the new season, but for every episode of the first two seasons thus far. Now it’s the perfect time to catch up with it.

As a Reincarnated Aristocrat Releases Full English Dub With Crunchyroll

As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World is now streaming the English dub for the anime’s first two seasons, and the first episode of the third season now airing its episodes as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule with new episodes then likely releasing on a weekly basis from now on. Directed by Manuel Aragon, the English dub for the series stars a core cast of Reshel Mae as Ars Louvent, Eli Farmer as Rietz Muses, Kara Edwards as Charlotte Reis, Hayden Daviau as Licia Pleide, Kayla Temshiv as Musia Trick and more.

It’s the perfect time to catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime thus far since As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3 is currently now airing its newest episodes. It features a returning production staff from the first two seasons with Takao Kato returning to direct for new studio GeyeG Pictures, Daisuke Ohigashi handling the scripts, Yuko Yahiro providing the character designs, and Kujira Yumemi composing the music.

Why You Should Catch Up With As a Reincarnated Aristocrat

As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I’ll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World likely isn’t the first Isekai anime franchise you think of when seeking out new releases this Fall, but it certainly has been one of the most compelling. If you’re a fan of the kinds of Isekai where the main character is building out an entire society (and thus needs to navigate politically in order to expand ), then this is the perfect show for you. It’s not the traditional power fantasy you see elsewhere by any means. In fact, its main characters is arguably one of the weaker characters in terms of strength.

Rather than Ars having a powerful ability that makes him the strongest person in this fantasy world , he instead is born with the ability to see the potential of all of those around him. Wanting to make his territory strong, he goes and recruits those with that hidden potential to make the most of them in new roles. The show sees each of these characters live up to that potential, and thus makes it all the more intriguing when they succeed. Are you going to check out this new English dub on Crunchyroll? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Nintendo Classics Service Adds Monster Rancher, Metal Slug, Kururin Paradise GBA Games
content:
Nintendo announced that it has added the Monster Rancher Advance , Metal Slug Advance , and Kururin Paradise games on the "Game Boy Advance – Nintendo Classics" app for the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack membership on Nintendo Switch 2 on Wednesday. This marks the first Western release for the previously Japan-only Kururin Paradise game. The company streamed a trailer:

Eighting and Nintendo 's Kururin Paradise originally launched for GBA in Japan in December 2002. The game is a sequel to Kuru Kuru Kururin , which originally got releases in Japan and Europe in 2001, but not in North America. Kuru Kuru Kururin eventually got releases in North America through the Wii U Virtual Console in 2016 and the "Game Boy Advance – Nintendo Classics" app in 2023.

Monster Rancher Advance ( Monster Farm Advance ) debuted for GBA in 2001. The Monster Rancher Advance 2 sequel game launched for GBA in 2002.

The first game in the Monster Rancher ( Monster Farm ) series debuted for PlayStation in 1997. The game tasks players with raising a variety of monsters to fight in tournaments, with players deciding how to raise the monster, which then determines how the monsters fight. A notable feature of many games in the series is the ability to generate a random monster dependent upon discs that players provide for the game to read. Monster Rancher 2 initially debuted for PlayStation in Japan in February 1999. The game then launched in North America in August 1999 and in Europe in October 2000.

The games inspired a 73-episode television anime series that ran from 1999 to 2001.

SNK released Metal Slug Advance for GBA in 2004.

The METAL SLUG ULTIMATE COLLECTION game will launch for Switch, Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in 2027.

title: The Legend of Korra Star Reacts to Surprise Reveal in Avatar: Seven Havens “Heartbreaking”
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens revealed that Korra is blamed for the destruction of the world with its premiere episode, and the original voice star behind Korra revealed she felt “hurt” when finding that out. Avatar: Seven Havens is the next big step in Avatar Studios’ expanding franchise, and takes place hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra . But one of the open secrets heading into the premiere was the fact that Korra is being blamed for the current post-apocalyptic state of the world all that time later.

The premiere episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens have made their debut with Paramount+ , and it’s been further revealed that the people of the various havens have grown to hate the Avatar for causing the destruction of the world. Revealing her thoughts about the reveal during the official Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise podcast, Avatar: Braving the Elements , Korra voice star Janet Varney explained that she had gone through a number of complicated emotions after, “I sobbed through this pilot episode. I was shattered. I cannot emphasize it enough.”

Korra’s Voice Actor Reacts to Avatar: Seven Havens Premiere

“I was like, ‘I’m so worried about all the people that love Korra and already defend Korra.’,” Varney continued. “And I had to go back and watch with fresh eyes after I had deeply grieved.” Explaining that she ultimately felt hurt due to her deep attachment to Korra, even if she knows there’s likely going to be more to the reveal later , “I know we don’t know what will happen, and I want people to keep the faith, but who knows? But just for me, watching children talk about her as if she’s a monster was heartbreaking. I mean, it really hurt.”

As Varney explains, it goes a bit deeper with Korra, “I’m not her, but I know what she means to some people, and it just really hurt.” Korra is currently teased to be the reason that the Avatar: Seven Havens world has been destroyed to the point where there are only seven civilizations left on Earth, but there’s likely much more to the story that Varney emphasizes will be revealed later. It’s hard to argue her emotions, however, as she understands better than everyone the kind of hate that could be thrown Korra’s way with such a reveal.

What Does This Mean for Korra in the Avatar Franchise?

Avatar: Seven Havens takes place two hundred years after the events of The Legend of Korra , and that raised a lot of questions about Korra’s life after the end of her series. This pocket of time will likely be explored in future episodes of the series (as teased by promotional materials like the teaser video above), and it’s likely that she’s just being blamed for it rather than being the root cause. It’s a natural extension of the kinds of adversity she faced during her time as the Avatar, and thus does unfortunately feel like a fitting continuation of her journey.

The Legend of Korra dealt with all sorts of complaints from fans when it was originally airing due to how different of a character Korra was from Aang, and unfortunately this reveal does make it easier for those who already hated the character to hate her more . But we’ll have to see whether or not Korra really did destroy the world. What did you think of this Korra reveal in Avatar: Seven Havens ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Switch 2 Remake Game's Overview Trailer Reveals Hall of Fallen Foes
content:
Nintendo began streaming on Wednesday an overview trailer for the Nintendo Switch 2 remake for the 1998 Nintendo 64 game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time , and it reveals the new Hall of Fallen Foes, an area where players can view statues of enemies they have defeated. Players can rematch bosses through the statues.

The game will launch on November 5.

The remake adds traditional camera controls, new motion controls, a proper jump button, and a roll dash action. Players can equip an item to the ZR button, and switch between them in a pop-up menu. A new Threads of Time menu helps players recap the story and recognize the next objective. Unlike the original game, time passes in town. Players can now hum into the Switch 2's microphone to play music in-game. The game also recognizes music from an ocarina that customers can purchase. The game also features added dialogue.

The game features compatibility with the Zelda Notes function in the Nintendo Switch App. Today's Record recaps a player's progress on the app. Gossip Quests functions as a scavenger hunt for points that can be exchanged for ocarina music scores. The scores can be used on the Play Ocarina function on the app. The app also includes an Ocarina of Time Quiz with over 2,000 questions. Rupees earned from the app can be used in-game and vice versa.

New amiibo for Young Link and Young Zelda will ship in 2027. Both will unlock in-game masks for the respective character. The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition of the Switch 2 console, and a matching Pro Controller and carrying case, will ship on October 29.

The original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time debuted for N64 in November 1998 in the U.S. and Japan, and in December 1998 in Europe and Australia. It is the fifth mainline game in The Legend of Zelda series, and it is the first game in the franchise to feature 3D graphics. The game has since received rereleases on various systems, including via two collection discs for Nintendo GameCube, the Virtual Console on Nintendo Wii, and the Nintendo Classics app on Nintendo Switch. The game got a remastered edition for Nintendo 3DS titled The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D in June 2011. The 3DS version, as well as one of the collection discs for GameCube, included a version of the game with different dungeons titled The Legend of Zelda : Master Quest based on a Nintendo 64DD title.

The game got a manga adaptation by Akira Himekawa , who has also drawn manga of other games in the franchise , in 2000. Viz Media has released the manga in English.

The franchise 's live-action film will open April 30, 2027, a week earlier from its previously planned May 7, 2027 opening date. The May 7, 2027 opening date was itself a delay from the film's original March 26, 2027 opening date. Unlike most games in the series, the film has no subtitle.

title: Teenage Mercenary to Make Crunchyroll Anime Debut in 2027 With Big Studio Behind It – Watch First Trailer
content:
Crunchyroll recently announced that it is going on an expedition to bring more manhwa anime adaptations to the industry. In the latest news, one of the most popular and diverse manhwa, Teenage Mercenary , has also been greenlit, with several details unveiled. The news came straight from the New York Comic Con event last weekend, where many anime adaptations of Korean webtoons were announced. However, the event proved to offer more than what was expected from these Korean webcomic adaptations. With the emergence of Solo Leveling in the anime industry, there is no doubt that its success has been the main catalyst for more anime adaptations following the same formula.

The year 2026 alone has seen two such anime that fans can’t help but compare to Solo Leveling . This is hardly surprising, as many similar series emerged following the success of the manhwa. However, the latest event has proven to break this pattern with two intriguing anime adaptations: The Boxer and Teenage Mercenary . The latter is arguably one of the most diverse webtoons out there, and with a studio like J.C. Staff at the helm of bringing the anime to life in 2027, the popular manhwa series could become the next big manhwa anime adaptation, especially as more details further solidify its potential.

Teenage Mercenary Could Be Crunchyroll’s Most Diverse Manhwa Anime Yet in 2027

In addition to J.C. Staff being revealed as the studio adapting the series, it was also announced that Manabu Ono will direct the anime, with Koji Haneda designing the characters and Solo Leveling veteran Hiroyuki Sawano composing the music. This certainly raises expectations for the upcoming Teenage Mercenary anime adaptation, despite J.C. Staff’s reputation for ruining One-Punch Man with its second season. Although the first teaser trailer has been revealed, it hasn’t offered enough details or visuals from the anime itself to judge the series’ quality.

However, it is already evident that the reason Teenage Mercenary could emerge as one of the best manhwa anime adaptations is its narrative. The series follows a boy who survives a plane crash at just eight years old, losing his parents in the process. Unfortunately, Ijin Yu ends up in a nation torn apart by war. For the next 10 years, Yu endures a brutal childhood, undergoing various types of training and even working as a spy. However, a decade later, Yu manages to reunite with his family, including his grandfather and sister. Upon returning, he faces his final year of high school, but Yu struggles to settle in and relies on the tactics he learned over the past decade to navigate the challenges of high school.

The series consistently explores themes of friendship and motivation, while its crime-thriller elements remain at the forefront, keeping fans engaged. With no supernatural elements, but rather a focus on training and how the human mind and body can evolve through difficult circumstances, Teenage Mercenary delivers an epic, thrilling narrative. It is by far one of the most exciting announcements among the array of webtoon adaptations , and with Crunchyroll slated to release it next year, fans can expect more details about Teenage Mercenary and a proper teaser to build even more hype for this epic adaptation.

title: Heavily Armed High School Girls Project Gets Smartphone RPG
content:
A website opened on Wednesday to announce a smartphone game for illustrator neco's Heavily Armed High School Girls ( Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei ) project. NextNinja is developing the JJK: Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei Wordless Record game. The website is also streaming an announcement trailer, and presented the game's main cast members.

JJK: Jū Heisōgata Joshi Kōsei Wordless Record is a casual idle role-playing game where players can interact and watch over the characters from a cat's perspective.

The game's main cast members are:

Rie Takahashi as Touka, a free-spirited first-year student and rookie member of the Ueno Sector's "Going Home Club." She does things at her own pace (including being half-asleep in class), but something changes within her the moment she decided to protect her friends.

Sayumi Suzushiro as Kanade, a first-year student who lifts and sets the mood of the "Going Home Club" trio. She enjoys life to the fullest, and she can strive through life with curiosity, thanks to her friends watching over her.

Yoshino Aoyama as Honami, a first-year student and member of the "Going Home Club." Despite her petiteness, she acts like a big sister, watching over Touka and Kanade. Still, she loses composure when she sees something cute, including the principal.

The Heavily Armed High School Girls project includes illustrations and figures, and is also getting a television anime that will air in 2027.

title: CloverWorks' Anime Film Grotesqqque to Feature Mika Ichinose Song
content:
The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "TERASE" sung by Mika Ichinose , one of the music contributors for the "A(E)liens" story. Singer-songwriter Ken Kamikita wrote the lyrics, and he scored and arranged the music. The song is now available on various music services, and the website also started streaming the song's collaboration music video with the film:

The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

The film's cast members and characters include :

For the "A(E)liens" story:

• Kana Ichinose as Ellie

• Gen Hoshino as Kento Kurikura

• Akio Ōtsuka as Space Agency Bureau Director

For the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story:

• Sara Minami as Stella

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Unknown (Nanashi)

• Saori Hayami as Hikarin

• Maaya Uchida as Gorgeous Mika

• Chika Anzai as Sword

• Miyu Tomita as Chiffon

• Rumi Ōkubo as Papico

• Rie Kugimiya as Poyomi

For the "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" story:

• Nagi Inoue (from Nogizaka46) as Ayame

• Aruno Nakanishi (from Nogizaka46) as Shion

• Miku Ichinose (from Nogizaka46) as Momo

• Nao Tomisato (from Nogizaka46) as Canna

The 35 musical acts contributing to each story in the film are:

"A(E)liens:"

• Mika Ichinose

• VaVa

• Ken Kamikita

• sabio/Fūta Takamura

• SEE

• Surii

• Taku Inoue

• tsumiki

• Yūshi Nakajima (from Gusokumuzu)

• Nanahira

• Hashimero

"Yoroshiku★Girl"

• ASCA

• Akki

• -otoha-

• Kotoko Satō (from yutori)

• Kanon Shizaki

• Ayato Shinozaki

• JUNNA

• Suisō

• Ryōsuke Tachibana

• Shiina Natsukawa

• Iori Noguchi (from =LOVE)

• Shōta Horie (also known as kemu)

• Myuk

• MIRI

• Rei Yasuda

• Yuyoyuppe

• Runaar

• Reol

"Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque"

• eba

• Nakano+

• Kairi Yagi

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) is directing the film, and is also writing the screenplay and designing the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film will open in Japan on November 6. The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2.

The Japan Society host the U.S. premiere of the film in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on October 8. Director Nishigori gave a pre-screening introduction in-person at the event.
